description: This file defines the PostList struct and associated methods for managing collections of Post objects in the Mattermost project, including cloning, serialization, sorting, and building WranglerPostList metadata.

classes.name: PostList
classes.description: A collection of posts with ordering, pagination, and metadata for use within the Mattermost system.

methods.name: NewPostList
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new PostList instance.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the PostList.

methods.name: ForPlugin
methods.description: Returns a copy of the PostList suitable for plugin use, with posts processed accordingly.

methods.name: ToSlice
methods.description: Converts the PostList to a slice of Post pointers in order.

methods.name: WithRewrittenImageURLs
methods.description: Returns a copy of the PostList with image URLs rewritten via provided function.

methods.name: StripActionIntegrations
methods.description: Removes action integration data from posts within the list.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes the PostList to a JSON string.

methods.name: EncodeJSON
methods.description: Encodes the PostList as JSON directly into an io.Writer.

methods.name: MakeNonNil
methods.description: Ensures that Order and Posts are non-nil, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: AddOrder
methods.description: Appends a post ID to the order list.

methods.name: AddPost
methods.description: Adds a post to the PostList, including handling burn-on-read posts.

methods.name: UniqueOrder
methods.description: Removes duplicate post IDs from the order list.

methods.name: Extend
methods.description: Merges another PostList into this one, maintaining order and uniqueness.

methods.name: SortByCreateAt
methods.description: Sorts the order list by post creation time descending.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Generates an ETag string based on the latest post update.

methods.name: IsChannelId
methods.description: Checks if all posts belong to a specific channel.

methods.name: BuildWranglerPostList
methods.description: Builds a WranglerPostList with metadata from the PostList.
